title: UI/UX Designer
description: Craft intuitive, accessible, and delightful digital user interfaces, user research studies, wireframes, and interactive design systems in Figma.

goal.objective: Create intuitive, user-centered digital interfaces that balance visual aesthetics with rigorous usability and accessibility standards.

learn.summary: Master user research, wireframing, Figma components and auto-layout, interactive micro-animations, design tokens, usability testing, and WCAG accessibility standards.
prerequisites: Visual design interest and empathy for users

capstone_projects.title: Comprehensive Multi-Platform Design System & Token Architecture
capstone_projects.description: Construct an enterprise-scale design system with multi-theme color tokens, accessible typography scales, modular components, and comprehensive design documentation.

capstone_projects.title: Accessible Complex B2B SaaS Workflow Redesign & Usability Case Study
capstone_projects.description: Lead an end-to-end redesign of an enterprise analytics workflow, documenting user research, wireframing iterations, usability test benchmarks, and measurable task improvements.

interview_focus: UX Research Methodologies (Generative vs Evaluative, Quantitative vs Qualitative)
Design System Scalability (Variables, Modes, Component Variants, Slot Patterns in Figma)
Information Architecture & User Mental Models in Complex Digital Products
Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.2 Level AA/AAA, Focus States, Color Contrast, Screen Readers)
Articulating Design Rationale & Measuring Product Design Impact on Business Metrics

tree.name: UX Fundamentals & User Research
tree.description: Master user experience fundamentals: Human-Centered Design (HCD), Design Thinking phases (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test), and cognitive psychology principles.

resources.title: Don't Make Me Think, Revisited by Steve Krug
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Introduction to Human-Centered Design & Design Thinking
children.description: Master Human-Centered Design: User empathy, participatory design workshops, iterative problem-solving cycles, and balancing business viability with user desirability.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Core UX Principles & Design Ethics
children.description: Apply core UX laws and ethical design: Hick's Law, Fitts's Law, Miller's Law, Jakob's Law, Gestalt principles, and eliminating deceptive dark patterns.

children.name: User Research Planning & Methodologies
children.description: Plan strategic user research: Defining research objectives, crafting research briefs, selecting qualitative/quantitative methodologies, and participant recruitment screening.

resources.title: NN/g User Research Methods: When to Use Which
When to Use Which UX Research Methods (Nielsen Norman Group)

children.name: Qualitative Research: Interviews, Surveys, Contextual Inquiry
children.description: Conduct qualitative discovery: Semi-structured user interviews, contextual inquiry, observation sessions, ethnographic field research, and diary studies.

resources.title: User Interviews: How to Conduct Them
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Quantitative Research: Analytics, A/B Testing, Benchmarking
children.description: Gather quantitative product signals: Analyzing Google Analytics / Mixpanel funnels, cohort retention heatmaps, user surveys (Likert scales), and benchmark surveys.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: User Analysis: Personas, Empathy Maps, Journey Maps
children.description: Synthesize user research models: Developing evidence-based user personas, empathy maps, customer journey maps, and service experience touchpoint matrices.

resources.title: Personas: The Foundation of a Great UX Strategy

children.name: Competitive Analysis & Market Research
children.description: Execute competitive benchmarking: Direct and indirect competitor heuristic audits, feature matrix comparisons, market gap identification, and SWOT analysis.

children.name: Stakeholder Interviews & Mapping
children.description: Align with enterprise stakeholders: Conducting executive stakeholder interviews, power-interest matrix mapping, and aligning design outcomes with business OKRs.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Synthesizing Research & Uncovering Actionable Insights
children.description: Synthesize research into product opportunities: Affinity mapping, thematic clustering, identifying latent pain points, and formulating actionable 'How Might We' (HMW) statements.

resources.title: Affinity Diagram: A Visual Tool for Organizing Ideas
My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

tree.name: Information Architecture & Interaction Design
tree.description: Architect information structures and intuitive interaction flows for complex digital applications.

resources.title: About Face: The Essentials of Interaction Design

children.name: Information Architecture Principles & Methods
children.description: Design information architecture: Content hierarchies, top-level navigation taxonomies, metadata schemas, open/closed card sorting, and tree testing.

resources.title: Card Sorting: What It Is & How to Do It
Tree Testing: How to Find the Right Information Structure

children.name: Content Strategy for UX & UX Writing
children.description: Integrate content design into UX: Writing concise microcopy, establishing brand voice and tone guidelines, error message design, and content readability.

resources.title: The Importance of Content Strategy in UX
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Interaction Design Principles: Laws of UX, Heuristics
children.description: Master interaction design heuristics: Nielsen Norman Group 10 usability heuristics, feedback loops, conceptual mental models, and progressive disclosure.

resources.title: Applying Gestalt Principles in UI Design
My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Common UI Patterns & Component States
children.description: Design comprehensive UI component states: Empty states, loading/skeleton states, error validation states, active/hover/focus states, and edge-case layouts.

resources.title: Designing System States: Empty, Loading, Error, Success

children.name: User Flows, Task Analysis & Wireframing
children.description: Map user journeys: Hierarchical task analysis (HTA), user flow diagrams, low-fidelity paper wireframes, and rapid divergent ideation sketches.

resources.title: Wireframes: The Basics of Good UX Design

children.name: Low-Fidelity Prototyping & Ideation
children.description: Build low-fidelity wireframes: Low-fidelity digital wireframes in Figma, click-through wireframe prototypes, and validating core navigational paths early.

resources.title: Crazy Eights: A Fast Sketching Exercise
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Form Design Best Practices
children.description: Design high-converting accessible forms: Single-column layouts, inline validation, clear field labels, intelligent input masking, and reducing cognitive friction.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Microinteractions & UI Animation
children.description: Design purposeful UI motion: Easing curves (cubic-bezier), micro-interaction feedback (button toggles, pull-to-refresh), and ensuring WCAG reduced-motion compliance.

resources.title: Microinteractions: Designing with Details by Dan Saffer
The Ultimate Guide to UI Animation

children.name: High-Fidelity Prototyping
children.description: Build interactive high-fidelity prototypes: Figma smart animate, interactive component variants, nested component state flows, and realistic user testing prototypes.

tree.name: UI & Visual Design Excellence
tree.description: Master visual hierarchy, layout grids, typography systems, and modern aesthetic standards.

resources.title: Refactoring UI by Adam Wathan and Steve Schoger
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Visual Design Fundamentals: Layout, Grids, Space
children.description: Master layout and composition: 8pt spatial grid systems, visual hierarchy, focal points, white space utilization, and balanced asymmetrical layouts.

resources.title: The 8-Point Grid System in UI Design
Using White Space in UX Design
My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Typography & Readability
children.description: Master typographic scales: Font pairing, modular type scales, line heights (`line-height: 1.5`), letter spacing, and optical hierarchy for legibility across devices.

resources.title: The Elements of Typographic Style by Robert Bringhurst

children.name: Color Theory & Application in UI
children.description: Apply color theory in UI: 60-30-10 color balance rule, semantic status palettes (success, warning, error, info), dark mode contrast ratios, and HSL color modeling.

resources.title: Color Anatomy, Themes and Tokens (Carbon Design System)

children.name: Iconography, Imagery & Branding
children.description: Curate visual assets: Consistent icon stroke weights, SVG vector optimization, authentic contextual photography, and cohesive illustration styles.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Responsive & Adaptive Design
children.description: Design responsive multi-device layouts: Mobile-first breakpoints (360px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px), fluid grids, adaptive touch targets (minimum 44x44px), and desktop dashboards.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Designing for Specific Platforms (iOS, Android, Web)
children.description: Design for platform conventions: Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) for iOS/macOS vs Google Material Design 3 for Android/Web.

children.name: Applying & Contributing to Design Systems
children.description: Utilize enterprise design systems: Consuming design tokens, contributing new variants, and maintaining UI consistency across cross-functional product squads.

resources.title: Using a Design System: A Guide for Designers

children.name: Design Critique & Feedback Processes
children.description: Facilitate design critique sessions: Giving and receiving constructive feedback, presenting rationale grounded in user research, and synthesizing feedback into iterations.

resources.title: The Art of Constructive Feedback in Design
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

tree.name: Figma Mastery & Design Systems
tree.description: Master Figma as an enterprise design tool: Auto Layout, component variants, variable tokens, and library management.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Figma Essentials: Tools, Frames, Text, Images
children.description: Master core Figma workflows: Frames vs groups, vector networks, typography styles, color styles, and keyboard shortcut mastery for maximum speed.

children.name: Auto Layout & Constraints in Figma
children.description: Master Figma Auto Layout: Vertical/horizontal stacking, gap distribution, padding, min/max dimensions, absolute positioning within auto layout, and responsive constraints.

children.name: Components, Variants & Component Properties
children.description: Build advanced Figma components: Component sets, variant properties, boolean visibility toggles, text replacement props, and nested instance swapping.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Advanced Prototyping & Animation in Figma
children.description: Master advanced Figma prototyping: Variables, expressions, conditional logic (`if/else`), scrolling containers, and realistic interactive prototypes.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Figma Plugins, Shortcuts & Workflow Optimization
children.description: Optimize Figma efficiency: Curating essential plugins (Stark, Autoflow, Content Reel, Unsplash), and establishing keyboard shortcut muscle memory.

resources.title: Best Figma Plugins for UI/UX Designers

children.name: Collaborative Workflows & Version Control in Figma
children.description: Manage collaborative design files: Figma branching, merging design changes, version history checkpoints, and multi-designer file organization.

children.name: Introduction to Design Systems & Tokens
children.description: Structure design system libraries: Defining color, typography, spacing, and elevation tokens; and publishing component libraries across organization workspaces.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Building & Maintaining a Design System Library
children.description: Maintain component libraries: Component documentation frames, usage guidelines, dos and don'ts, and maintaining changelog release notes.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

tree.name: Accessibility, Testing & Handoff
tree.description: Enforce accessibility standards, conduct usability testing, and execute seamless developer handoffs.

children.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
children.description: Master WCAG 2.1 AA & AAA standards: Contrast ratios (4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI elements), keyboard focus indicators, non-color visual cues, and accessible text alternatives.

resources.title: Designing for Web Accessibility - WAI Tutorials

children.name: Inclusive Design Practices & Assistive Technologies
children.description: Design inclusive interfaces: Catering to situational, temporary, and permanent impairments; screen reader accessibility (ARIA semantics), and cognitive accessibility.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Accessibility Testing & Auditing Tools
children.description: Audit accessibility: Automated testing with Stark Figma plugin, axe DevTools, contrast analyzers, and simulating color blindness deficiencies.

resources.title: Axe DevTools for Web Accessibility Testing
My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Usability Testing Methods & Planning
children.description: Plan and moderate usability testing: Moderated think-aloud testing, unmoderated remote testing (UserTesting, Maze), task completion metrics, and System Usability Scale (SUS).

children.name: Analyzing Test Results & Reporting Findings
children.description: Analyze usability findings: Calculating Single Ease Question (SEQ) scores, severity rating usability issues, and sharing highlight reels with cross-functional teams.

children.name: Design Handoff & Developer Collaboration (Figma Dev Mode)
children.description: Execute seamless developer handoffs: Figma Dev Mode, inspecting CSS/tokens, providing redline measurements, exporting optimized SVG/PNG assets, and writing implementation notes.

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Cross-functional Communication & Stakeholder Management
children.description: Collaborate with engineers and product managers: Negotiating scope, sprint grooming participation, design QA audits in staging, and resolving technical feasibility tradeoffs.

resources.title: Share User Research Findings with Stakeholders (GOV.UK Service Manual)
My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Post-Launch Monitoring & Design Iteration
children.description: Monitor post-launch design metrics: Tracking user telemetry, feature adoption rates, heatmaps with Hotjar, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and continuous iteration.

resources.title: Choosing UX Metrics from Goals (Nielsen Norman Group)

tree.name: Portfolio & Career Development
tree.description: Build a world-class UI/UX design portfolio: Case studies, whiteboard challenges, and positioning for senior product design roles.

children.name: Crafting UX Case Studies: Problem, Process, Solution, Impact
children.description: Author compelling UX case studies: Structuring narrative (Problem Statement, Business Context, Research Discovery, Iterative Exploration, Final Solution, Measurable Impact).

resources.title: Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Building Your Portfolio Website: Best Practices
children.description: Build an online design portfolio: Curating 3-4 deep-dive case studies, responsive personal website design, clear storytelling, and accessible typography.

resources.title: My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Resume & LinkedIn Optimization
children.description: Optimize design resumes: Highlighting quantifiable product outcomes (e.g. 'reduced checkout drop-off by 24%'), design leadership skills, and ATS keyword alignment.

resources.title: LinkedIn for UX Designers: Tips & Tricks

children.name: Interview Preparation: Portfolio Reviews, Whiteboard Challenges
children.description: Master UX design interviews: Presenting portfolio case studies, solving live 45-minute whiteboard design challenges, and answering app critique questions.

children.name: Networking & Mentorship
children.description: Engage with the design community: Participating in design meetups, seeking mentorship on ADPList, and contributing to open design discussions.

resources.title: Networking for UX Designers: A Practical Guide
Figma Tutorial for UI Design - Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Personal Branding & Online Presence
children.description: Build a design brand: Sharing design insights on LinkedIn/X, publishing Figma Community templates, and writing UX case studies on Medium/Substack.

resources.title: Building Your Personal Brand as a Designer
Writing Articles to Demonstrate Expertise (Nielsen Norman Group)
My 5-Step UX/UI Design Process — From Start to Deliver (Faizur Rehman)

children.name: Career Paths: Freelance, Agency, In-House
children.description: Evaluate design career paths: Comparing agency client delivery, startup generalist breadth, enterprise specialized design systems, and freelance consulting.

children.name: Continuous Learning & Industry Trends
children.description: Stay ahead of industry shifts: Spatial computing UI (visionOS), generative AI design patterns, voice user interfaces (VUI), and conversational UX.

resources.title: Top UX Design Trends to Watch
